channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Pelle Larsson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Pelle Larsson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson
item.description:
Spoelstra on Larsson:

“He's relentless, so he's going to make you make decisions. Not just for the coach, but for the front office. Whatever his role may be, he's going to continue to impose his will, on the game, on me. The way this team is built fits his competitive nature. He had a tremendous offseason.”

Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson, Sep 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra:

“But I want to see how many times he (Pelle Larsson) gets hit in the face, per game. It's gotta be number 1 in the league.”

Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson, Nov 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson
item.description:
Spoelstra said of Jakucionis.

“He has a kamikaze element to him. Him and Pelle [Larsson] are going to spend a lot of time on the ground. But he’s like jet fuel. You just immediately feel his energy and his speed.”

Erik Spoelstra on Pelle Larsson, Oct 10, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.
